title: Big Game Sportfishing
specs: Targets all major gamefish of the Northeast Canyons including tuna, marlin, dolphin, wahoo, swordfish, sharks
Light tackle shark fishing for 300 pound sharks
Trophy striped bass fishing considered some of the best on the planet
No smoking, alcohol, or profanity by captain and mate on charters
Can coordinate charters for large groups with multiple boats for company outings, bachelor parties, birthdays, family fun, and tournaments

options.name: Canyon Fishing
options.detail: Offshore big game fishing targeting tuna, marlin, sharks, mahi, and wahoo from early June through October.

options.name: Light Tackle Striped Bass Fishing
options.detail: Light tackle, live bait fishing for trophy striped bass.

options.name: Light Tackle Shark Fishing
options.detail: Fishing for 300 pound sharks on light spinning gear.

options.name: Blackfish Fishing
options.detail: Trophy blackfish fishing from October 15th to December 15th aboard Big Game II with heated cabin and large cockpit.

options.name: Cod Fishing
options.detail: Year-round cod fishing from April 1st through February 1st aboard Big Game II with heated cabin and large cockpit.

options.name: Shoot and Fish Package
options.detail: Includes morning at Peace Dale Shooting Preserve and afternoon fishing targeting striped bass, fluke, sea bass, bluefish, and albies.
